title: Los Alamos tiger team security test failed

tellings.quote: they called it the tiger team came in to test security there, and they failed so horribly

plain: A man named Bob Lazar, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes on something he says he was told about Los Alamos, the government laboratory in New Mexico, around 1990 or 1991. According to Lazar, a "tiger team", a group brought in to test a site's security by trying to get past it, came to check security there, and the place failed very badly. He tells it as a sign of how weak security was at one of the country's most sensitive sites.
